subject: general
question: A man borrows Rs. 15,000 at 15% p.a. compound interest. At the end of every year, he pays Rs. 2,500 as part repayment. How much does he still owe after three such instalments?
solution:
**Given:**

Man borrows Rs. 15,000 at 15% p.a. compound interest

 At the end of every year, he pays Rs. 2,500 as part repayment

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)T

**Calculation:**

Amount which has to paid after 1 year = A = P(1 + R/100)T

⇒ 15000(1 + 15/100)¹

⇒ 15000 × 115/100

⇒ 17250
